entry_pools: newcomer tenure=1, returner tenure>1, unknown otherwise; no cross-pool donors
joint_answer: Whole ten-bin Q9 plus cached mean/IQR and optional independently valid Q8; never mean-bin copies
independent_q8: A separate same-rule point bank uses every valid selected Core Q8, including unusable Q9. Q9-valid/Q8-missing joint atoms remain available for Q9. Whole-payload Normal visualisations do not fabricate missing paired answers.
parent: Same-entry, disjoint other fine cells, maximal number of matching known demographic coordinates; all such nearest cells pooled with corrected Core weights
weights: SRSWOR within fine allocation cells (unknown separate), pi=n/N, original w/pi and within-cell calibration to known frame masses. Expansion integrates the complete target mass once.
aggregation_primary: Finite population: valid Core retain their actual original population mass at observed answers; only Normal and explicitly missing Core fields use posterior predictive distributions. Core design weights estimate distributions, not an extra full-population mass to add again.
implementation_revision: Whole-cell v1 predictions remain archived. Finite v2 enforces the structural census limit (all valid Core -> exact observed distribution), without changing the development-only tau rule or choosing a new demographic grid.
human_check: Sample Core before looking at current answers from all positive-weight profiles. Only selected legal current Q9 answers enter this evaluation-only surrogate Core. Compare remaining Normal people, then full population, to observed valid human responses.
human_score: Official cached individual Q9 mean/IQR for both Core and target, no new fits; statistics-only feasibility, never LLM simulation performance.
parameter_selection: Development-only within each Core budget: choose tau among 0,8,24 by mean Normal-only W1 subject to mean median-MAE no more than 0.05pp above tau0. Ties prefer smaller tau. Fixed before temporal summaries.
human_holdout_limit: Core and Normal are disjoint within month. Person may appear across months; later periods already inspected and not independent blind validation. Human Core answers are not permitted production LLM inputs.
cached_llm_check: Fixed random_quantity V3.2 answers, two repeats separately. Subsample 64 of 96 /128 of192, floor1. Reconstruct saved full-LLM target distribution and compare to human truth separately. This is an existing-sample conditional check, not evidence for 256 Core representing a full SCE wave.
